// Format email with tax prep summary const data = $input.first().json; const { quarter, year, revenue, totals, flaggedExpenses, expensesByIRSCategory } = data; const sheetsUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${$env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_FINANCE_ID}`; // Build category breakdown let categoryRows = ''; Object.entries(expensesByIRSCategory) .sort((a, b) => b[1].total - a[1].total) .forEach(([category, data]) => { const percentage = totals.totalDeductible > 0 ? ((data.total / totals.totalDeductible) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0; categoryRows += ` ${category} ${data.count} $${data.total.toFixed(2)} ${percentage}% `; }); // Build flagged items let flaggedRows = ''; flaggedExpenses.slice(0, 10).forEach(exp => { flaggedRows += ` ${exp.merchant} $${exp.amount.toFixed(2)} ${exp.date} Row ${exp.rowNumber} `; }); const emailHtml = `

${quarter} ${year} Tax Prep Package

Important Tax Information

Your quarterly tax preparation documents are ready for review.

Summary

Gross Revenue: $${revenue.grossRevenue.toFixed(2)}
Deductible Expenses: $${totals.totalDeductible.toFixed(2)}
Estimated Taxable Income: $${totals.taxableIncome.toFixed(2)}
Estimated Tax Owed (~25%): $${totals.estimatedTax.toFixed(2)}

Expense Breakdown by IRS Category

${categoryRows}
Category Count Total %
${flaggedExpenses.length > 0 ? `

Missing Receipts (${flaggedExpenses.length} expenses - $${totals.totalFlagged.toFixed(2)})

These expenses may not be deductible without proper documentation.

${flaggedRows}
Merchant Amount Date Location
${flaggedExpenses.length > 10 ? `

...and ${flaggedExpenses.length - 10} more

` : ''}
` : ''}

Next Steps

  1. Review all flagged items and add missing receipts
  2. Verify expense categorizations
  3. Consult with tax professional if needed
  4. File estimated quarterly taxes

View in Google Sheets

This report is for informational purposes only. Please consult with a licensed tax professional for tax advice.

`; return [{ json: { ...data, emailHtml, emailSubject: `${quarter} ${year} Tax Prep Ready - $${totals.estimatedTax.toFixed(2)} Estimated Tax` } }];
